description: Explicit multiway join-resolution reuse experiment on the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Scalar, PK, two-table indexed_join and historical three_table_join retain exact prior SQL and schedules. New hit/miss and four-table shapes restrict every input by primary-key equality. The computed-key shape maps the PK-bound outer id modulo 10 into two explicitly bounded inner PK ranges of at most10 rows. The three-table range explicitly bounds every input to at most100 rows. The multiway LEFT fence is an unsupported cache control with at most one primary-key match and preserves NULL extension. All results are completely drained; exact values, metadata and costs are checked against the Rust Ruby binding before timing.

workloads.name: pk_hit
workloads.sql: SELECT score FROM items WHERE id = $1

workloads.name: indexed_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

workloads.name: three_table_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: three_table_join_miss
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: three_table_join_range
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id < $1 AND b.id < $1 AND c.id < $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: three_table_computed_key
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id % 10 JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id < 10 AND c.id < 10 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: four_table_join
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label, d.bucket FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id JOIN items d ON d.id = c.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 AND d.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

workloads.name: three_table_left_fence
workloads.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id LEFT JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id AND c.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id
